tribal_knowledge.tip: For ruled surfaces, use swarf cutting with CURVE_CONTACT=1 for better surface finish
TILT_STRATEGY=12 (Automatic) works best for complex freeform surfaces
Set LEAD_ANGLE and LEADUP_ANGLE to 3-5 deg for titanium blisks to reduce tool wear
MAXX barrel cutters achieve 10x stepover vs ball nose for same scallop height
Set RADIAL_LIFT=1 with RADIAL_ANGLE=45 for chip evacuation in deep grooves
Always use CSS_MODE=1 for consistent surface finish across diameter changes
